subjective.unit: Chief Complaint: The patient presents with complaints of depression, asthma, and diabetes.
subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: I'm 59 years old, male, and I'm here for a routine follow-up of my chronic problems. I've been dealing with depression, asthma, and diabetes, and I wanted to check in on how everything's been going. Doctor: Could you please provide more details about your current symptoms or concerns related to your depression, asthma, or diabetes? Patient: Sure. My depression has been kind of persistent, and I've been having some ups and downs with it. I've been weening myself off my medication, Prozac, because I felt some side effects, but I'm willing to try something else if needed. As for my asthma, it's been acting up a bit more this season because of the pollen, and I've been using my inhaler more when it's hot. I did feel a little lightheaded and dizzy the other day, but I thought it was just the heat. My diabetes has been manageable, but I did slip a bit with my diet over the weekend because we were traveling for sports tournaments and eating on the go. I'm trying to get back on track with my diet and monitoring my blood sugars. Doctor: Could you provide details about the specific side effects you experienced with Prozac and whether you have consulted with your psychiatrist about tapering off the medication? Patient: I didn't really talk to my psychiatrist about tapering off; I just kind of did it myself because I felt like I was starting to feel better, but now I'm realizing I might need to get back on something or try a different medication. The side effects were more like feeling a bit sluggish or having some stomach discomfort, but nothing too severe. Doctor: Has the patient experienced any changes in his diabetes management plan, such as adjustments in insulin or oral hypoglycemic agents, since the slip in diet control? Patient: No, I haven't made any changes to my diabetes management plan since the slip in diet control
